title: Cognizability, compoundability, and so on of offences
chapter: Chapter VIII — Offences, Penalties, and Trial
text: Cognizability, compoundability, and so on of offences.— Offences under sections 33 and 34 shall be cognizable, non-bailable and non-co mpoundable, and offences under sections 31, 32, and 35 shall be non-cognizable, bailable and compoundable.
source: Overseas Employment and Migrants Act 2013 (official English translation)
verify_note: Text extracted from a third-party mirror of the official English translation. Compare with the Legislative Division PDF and, where the Bangla and English texts differ, section 48(2) makes the Bangla text authoritative.
